purpose: Test the predeclared one-round all-selected-anchor refinement on the closest saved U2 development underfill.

input.single_source_derivation: Exact candidate_sources[6] from the immutable development freeze; patient and source identity retained.

candidate_contract.trigger: Saved topology-passing area underfill on selected multi-anchor interfaces.
candidate_contract.choice_rule: Within each selected interface, bisect every original anchor that was selected, freshly nuclei-feasible, and legally bisectable; rank anchors by mask area then stable id only for deterministic execution.

failure_policy: Any mismatch, timeout, exception, incomplete receipt, or failure to bind the frozen source is HOLD with no retry.
authorization_basis: Codex self-authorized one development counterexample after 41 focused tests passed and the complete 15-patient development result showed thirty U1 and fourteen U2 failures reached the one-anchor-only selected-refinement path.
